item.name: Kitchen_Propane_Supply
item.description: Propane cylinder and connections supplying the communal kitchen.
item.location: At the communal kitchen cooking area.
item.readyForNextPerson: The supply is not empty, is upright and secured, and has no hissing, propane odor, or frost at a connection.
item.ifNotReady: Stop cooking. Do not operate a valve or replace a cylinder unless the Dominatrix authorizes you. Tell the Dominatrix immediately.
